domain.description: The host name the server asked about.

available.description: false when the server could not fetch the list. Then only reason and retry_after_seconds follow. It is true for a host without a capture too.

reason.description: Present only when available is false. It is quota_exhausted: the server reached its request limit for the source.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the server sends that request again. Present only when available is false.

first_seen.description: It is the day of the earliest capture, as YYYY-MM-DD. null when the host has no capture.

last_seen.description: It is the day of the latest capture, as YYYY-MM-DD. null when the host has no capture.

years_online.description: It is the year of last_seen minus the year of first_seen, and 1 when that difference is 0. It spans the archive's captures, not the domain's age. null when the host has no capture.

captured_at.description: It is a UTC time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

http_status.description: null when the archive lists no status.

latest_captures.description: It lists the latest days with a capture, at most 10, the latest first. Each day shows one capture of it.

archive_url.description: It links to the host's page on the Wayback Machine.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
